chunks: And by this chain, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) who said: We were with the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) in digging the ditch when Fatima came to him with a piece of bread; and she gave it to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family),

the Prophet (peace be upon him and the purification) asked: What is this piece of bread? She said: I baked loaves for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn, and I brought you this piece of it; the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed, this is the first food that entered your father's mouth since three (nights).

key_terms.الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ: Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn, the grandsons of the Prophet.
key_terms.الْخَنْدَقِ: The Ditch (Khandaq), a defensive trench dug by Muslims during the Battle of the Confederates.
key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ: Fatima, the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say when Fatima brought him bread during the digging of the Ditch?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the profound sacrifice of the Ahl al-Bayt during the Battle of the Ditch, illustrating the close familial bond between the Prophet and Fatima al-Zahra. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the spiritual and physical hardships endured by the Prophet's household, reinforcing their status as models of patience and devotion in Shia tradition.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-123 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, “I was with the Prophet (S) digging a ditch when (the Blessed Lady) Fatima (a.s.) came with a piece of bread for the Prophet (S).

The Prophet asked her, “Where is this piece of bread from?” She (a.s.) replied, “I baked a loaf of bread for Al-Hassan and Al-Husayn and brought you a piece of it.” The Prophet (S) said, “This is the first piece of bread that has reached your father’s mouth after three nights and days.”
